construction.algorithm: Iteratively remove traits with degree <5 families and families with degree <2 traits until no more removals occur.
construction.order_invariance: At each iteration compute both degree filters from the same current graph, remove their union simultaneously, then repeat.

rationale: The crossed random-effects question requires replication of traits across families and families across traits; this gate is frozen before any real memory rho is opened.
